description: This source file implements the Time class and related functions for date/time parsing, formatting, and conversions, supporting both Windows and POSIX systems. It includes methods for parsing various date formats, converting between local and UTC time, and computing Julian dates and NTP time.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: A class representing date and time, with methods for parsing, formatting, and conversions supporting Windows and POSIX systems.

methods.name: Time::FromANSI
methods.description: Parses an ANSI string in asctime() format into a Time object.

methods.name: Time::FromRFC1123
methods.description: Parses an RFC 1123 date string into a Time object.

methods.name: Time::FromRFC1036
methods.description: Parses an RFC 1036 date string into a Time object.

methods.name: Time::FromISO8601
methods.description: Parses an ISO8601 date string into a Time object.

methods.name: Time::ToLocal
methods.description: Converts the Time object to local time.

methods.name: Time::ToUTC
methods.description: Converts the Time object to UTC.

methods.name: Time::Ticks
methods.description: Returns the time in microseconds since epoch.

methods.name: Time::Format
methods.description: Formats the Time object into a string based on a formatter.

methods.name: Time::DayOfWeek
methods.description: Returns the day of the week.

methods.name: Time::DayOfYear
methods.description: Returns the day of the year.

methods.name: Time::ToTimeOnly
methods.description: Returns the time portion as a string.

methods.name: Time::ToRFC1123
methods.description: Returns the date in RFC 1123 format.

methods.name: Time::ToISO8601
methods.description: Returns the date in ISO8601 format.

methods.name: Time::IsValidDate
methods.description: Checks if a date is valid.
